title: UI操作繁琐且不直观
description: 界面操作需要过多点击、滚动和拖拽，缺乏便捷的交互方式，导致操作繁琐、不直观。
evidence: You can not pull both of these menus up at the same time.
Can't determine what is what from ceiling to floor, other than mouse over
There is no exit button on the main page

evidence_items.quote: Tons of desperately needed QoL is simply non-existent which makes the gameplay often a chore or mess.
evidence_items.description: 大量急需的生活质量功能缺失，使游戏体验繁琐混乱
evidence_items.quote_zh: 大量迫切需要的体验优化根本就不存在，这使得游戏过程常常变成一件苦差事或一团乱麻。

evidence_items.quote: everytime you go to the social app, you have to re-find the person everytime and there is not search bar
evidence_items.description: 社交应用没有搜索栏，每次都要滚动列表重新找人
evidence_items.quote_zh: 每次你打开社交应用，都得重新找那个人，而且没有搜索栏

evidence_items.quote: the player is stuck manually going through every storage bin and toolbox looking for items to equip NPCs
evidence_items.description: 玩家被迫手动翻遍每个储物箱和工具箱来为NPC装备物品
evidence_items.quote_zh: 玩家只能手动翻遍每一个储物箱和工具箱，寻找可以装备给NPC的物品

evidence_items.quote: The UX IS still pretty intimidating and definitely needs more polish
evidence_items.description: 用户体验仍然令人生畏，需要更多打磨。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 用户体验仍然相当令人望而生畏，肯定还需要更多打磨

evidence_items.quote: менеджмент инвентаря обычно ад из матрёшки
evidence_items.description: 物品栏管理如套娃般繁琐
evidence_items.quote_zh: 物品栏管理通常是套娃般的地狱

evidence_items.quote: There is also little QoL
evidence_items.description: 缺乏生活质量改进
evidence_items.quote_zh: 而且几乎没有生活质量方面的便利

evidence_items.quote: The emotion system hours of clicking esoteric talking buttons to get a tiny change in your characters emotional needs
evidence_items.description: 情绪系统需要大量点击晦涩的对话按钮
evidence_items.quote_zh: 情绪系统要花好几个小时点击那些晦涩难懂的对话按钮，才能让你角色的情绪需求发生一丁点变化

evidence_items.quote: docking and undocking takes way more clicks that it should
evidence_items.description: 对接和脱离需要过多点击
evidence_items.quote_zh: 停靠和脱离停靠所需的点击次数远超应有水平

evidence_items.quote: A Quick Action Bar that impressively adds more hurdle in your way by being designed like a wack-a-mole game.
evidence_items.description: 快捷操作栏设计得像打地鼠游戏，增加操作障碍
evidence_items.quote_zh: 一个快捷操作栏，其设计得像打地鼠游戏，令人印象深刻地在你面前增添了更多障碍。

evidence_items.quote: When work stops, the game gives zero feedback on why (missing parts, dead battery, or personal needs/morale issue). Having to manually check every single variable is extremely tedious.
evidence_items.description: 工作停止时游戏不提供任何原因反馈，需手动检查每个变量
evidence_items.quote_zh: 当工作停止时，游戏完全不给出原因反馈（缺少零件、电池没电，还是个人需求/士气问题）。不得不手动检查每一个变量，极其繁琐。

evidence_items.quote: building ships is pretty brute-force and kind of a headache, given the crudity of the tools to do so
evidence_items.description: 飞船建造工具粗糙，操作困难
evidence_items.quote_zh: 建造飞船相当粗暴，而且有点令人头疼，因为用于建造的工具非常粗糙。

evidence_items.quote: More control over the automatic pause/unpause system would be nice, because it never seems to do what i want it to.
evidence_items.description: 自动暂停/取消暂停系统不按预期工作
evidence_items.quote_zh: 如果能有更多对自动暂停/取消暂停系统的控制就好了，因为它似乎从来不做我想让它做的事。

evidence_items.quote: Even earlier could have a dockign request button vs. the current hail ship, hail again, pick dock that goes on.
evidence_items.description: 对接需要多次呼叫和选择，缺乏自动对接或简化流程
evidence_items.quote_zh: 更早的时候本可以有一个停靠请求按钮，而不是现在这样：呼叫船只、再次呼叫、选择停靠，如此反复。

evidence_items.quote: painful interfaces
evidence_items.description: 界面操作令人痛苦
evidence_items.quote_zh: 令人痛苦的界面

evidence_items.quote: upakowane w archaiczne, niewygodne, mozolne systemy z wyskakującym piedylionem okienek
evidence_items.description: 界面系统陈旧不便，窗口弹出繁琐
evidence_items.quote_zh: 塞进了陈旧、不便、繁琐的系统里，还伴随着一堆弹出的窗口

evidence_items.quote: The UI make everything tedious.
evidence_items.description: UI使所有操作变得繁琐
evidence_items.quote_zh: UI让一切都变得繁琐。

evidence_items.quote: UI is ass but eh, you get used to it
evidence_items.description: UI很差
evidence_items.quote_zh: UI很烂，但呃，你会习惯的

evidence_items.quote: it's *very* tedious to build out a ship in-game
evidence_items.description: 在游戏中建造飞船非常繁琐
evidence_items.quote_zh: 在游戏内建造一艘飞船*非常*繁琐

evidence_items.quote: picking up items feels bad because it's all buried behind a user interface
evidence_items.description: 拾取物品被埋在UI后面，操作不便
evidence_items.quote_zh: 捡起物品的感觉很差，因为这一切都埋在一个用户界面后面

evidence_items.quote: the build planer feels bad to use
evidence_items.description: 建造规划器使用体验差
evidence_items.quote_zh: 建造规划器用起来感觉很糟

evidence_items.quote: UI make you hate self so bad! Make you think it on purpose.
evidence_items.description: 界面令人困惑，玩家不知道如何操作
evidence_items.quote_zh: UI让你恨自己恨得不行！让你觉得它是故意的。

evidence_items.quote: the interface really gets in the way of the gameplay experience
evidence_items.description: 界面混乱笨拙，阻碍游戏体验
evidence_items.quote_zh: 界面真的妨碍了游戏体验

evidence_items.quote: Picking out different items on the floor is horrible
evidence_items.description: 在地板上挑选不同物品很糟糕
evidence_items.quote_zh: 在地板上挑拣不同的物品简直糟透了

evidence_items.quote: Everything feels awfully "disconnected" from the player, its like fighting the UI/UX as everything is a bit complicated.
evidence_items.description: UI/UX复杂，操作起来像在跟界面搏斗
evidence_items.quote_zh: 一切都让人感觉与玩家极其“脱节”，就像在跟UI/UX搏斗，因为一切都有点复杂。

evidence_items.quote: a mix of RPG text-based chat with a tiny ass window you have to scroll into to do things. you have to pause every 2 seconds to read what is going on.
evidence_items.description: NPC对话窗口过小需频繁滚动，且需频繁暂停阅读
evidence_items.quote_zh: 一种RPG文字聊天，配上一个你得滚进去才能操作的小得可怜的窗口。你每2秒就得暂停一下去读正在发生什么。

evidence_items.quote: most of the time you misslick and select another element since everything is so pixelized you don't know where it starts and ends.
evidence_items.description: 像素化导致元素边界不清，经常误选其他元素
evidence_items.quote_zh: 大多数时候你会点错并选中另一个元素，因为一切都像素化得让你不知道它从哪里开始、到哪里结束。

evidence_items.quote: an aggravating UI
evidence_items.description: UI令人恼火，存在重大QoL问题
evidence_items.quote_zh: 令人恼火的UI

evidence_items.quote: the UI could have a little overhaul
evidence_items.description: UI需要改进
evidence_items.quote_zh: UI 可以稍微翻新一下

evidence_items.quote: the art direction and UI make every moment a fight to do what you need to
evidence_items.description: 美术方向和UI让每个操作都变成挣扎
evidence_items.quote_zh: 美术风格和UI让每一刻都变成一场苦战，才能做成你需要做的事

evidence_items.quote: A UI that feels like it was designed to make you suffer.
evidence_items.description: UI设计让人难受
evidence_items.quote_zh: 一个感觉像是专门设计来让你受苦的UI。

evidence_items.quote: Alien docking UI
evidence_items.description: 对接界面存在问题
evidence_items.quote_zh: 外星对接界面

evidence_items.quote: Every few minutes, you find yourself returning to the ship just to remove your helmet, put it back on again, and carry on.
evidence_items.description: 每隔几分钟就要回船摘头盔再戴上
evidence_items.quote_zh: 每隔几分钟，你就会发现自己回到飞船上，只是为了摘下头盔、再重新戴上，然后继续干活。

evidence_items.quote: The UI has improved over the years but can still be exceptionally clunky
evidence_items.description: UI笨重，寻找存储物品困难，打开嵌套容器需要大量点击和时间
evidence_items.quote_zh: 这些年来UI有所改进，但仍然可能极其笨拙

evidence_items.quote: The game has a very steep skill floor, like many games. Learning the UI takes time and this may overwhelm some players
evidence_items.description: UI学习曲线陡峭，可能让部分玩家不知所措
evidence_items.quote_zh: 和许多游戏一样，这款游戏的上手门槛非常陡峭。学习UI需要时间，这可能会让一些玩家不知所措

evidence_items.quote: слишком много кликов нужно сделать чтобы поставить хоть что-то и нет абсолютно никаких "шорткатов"
evidence_items.description: 放置蓝图需要过多点击且没有快捷键
evidence_items.quote_zh: 要放置哪怕一点点东西都需要点击太多次，而且完全没有任​​何“快捷键”

evidence_items.quote: the way and the steps needed for the player to interact with the environment to achieve even the most mundane of tasks is just completely idiotic
evidence_items.description: 交互系统繁琐，完成简单任务需要过多步骤
evidence_items.quote_zh: 玩家为了完成哪怕是最平凡的任务而与环境互动所需的方式和步骤，简直完全是白痴透顶

evidence_items.quote: You can not pull both of these menus up at the same time.
evidence_items.description: 建造菜单和订单菜单无法同时打开
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你无法同时打开这两个菜单。

evidence_items.quote: when you go back to the build menu, you've lost your place and have to find the tiles you were working with
evidence_items.description: 返回建造菜单时丢失之前的位置
evidence_items.quote_zh: 当你回到建造菜单时，你已经丢失了原来的位置，不得不重新找到你之前正在使用的那些地砖。

evidence_items.quote: Context-menu-based interaction will wear and tear you more than your ship.
evidence_items.description: 基于上下文菜单的交互方式令人疲惫
evidence_items.quote_zh: 基于上下文菜单的交互方式对你的磨损比对你的飞船还大。

evidence_items.quote: a UI that while much better than early on in development can be a bit cumbersome
evidence_items.description: UI有时显得笨重
evidence_items.quote_zh: 一个虽然比开发早期好得多、但仍可能有点笨拙的UI

evidence_items.quote: General UI/UX is on "I'm an artist" level.
evidence_items.description: 整体UI/UX设计粗糙
evidence_items.quote_zh: 整体UI/UX处于“我是个艺术家”的水平。

evidence_items.quote: the flight menu feels like Asteroids had a child with excel
evidence_items.description: 飞行菜单界面复杂难懂
evidence_items.quote_zh: 飞行菜单感觉像是《小行星》和Excel生的孩子

evidence_items.quote: Many actions require excessive clicking
evidence_items.description: 许多操作需要过多点击
evidence_items.quote_zh: 许多操作需要过度点击

evidence_items.quote: The UI is incredibly clunky and difficult to navigate
evidence_items.description: UI非常笨重且难以导航
evidence_items.quote_zh: 用户界面极其笨重，难以导航

evidence_items.quote: does not remember their window positions so you have to rearrange it any time you open and close
evidence_items.description: UI窗口不记住位置，每次打开关闭都需要重新排列
evidence_items.quote_zh: 不记得它们的窗口位置，所以你每次打开和关闭时都得重新排列

evidence_items.quote: Super cluttery UI
evidence_items.description: UI非常杂乱
evidence_items.quote_zh: 超级杂乱的UI

evidence_items.quote: The UI is a little unintuitive. Left click move, right click show infos, which you get in the upper right. Then you have to look into the middle lower side of the screen to see interactions.
evidence_items.description: UI不直观，操作和信息显示位置分散
evidence_items.quote_zh: UI有点不直观。左键移动，右键显示信息，信息在右上角。然后你还得看屏幕中下方才能看到交互选项。

evidence_items.quote: It has a deliberately awkward UI, reminiscent of Barotrauma/Space Station 13 sort of games.
evidence_items.description: UI刻意设计得笨拙，操作不便
evidence_items.quote_zh: 它有一个刻意做得别扭的UI，让人想起Barotrauma/太空站13那类游戏。

evidence_items.quote: The clickdrag menu has bounds poorly defined, game is made of tiles, sometimes a row of tiles is missed
evidence_items.description: 点击拖拽菜单边界定义差，有时会漏选一排格子。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 点击拖拽菜单的边界定义得很差，游戏是由格子组成的，有时会漏掉一整行格子

evidence_items.quote: The UI is horrific
evidence_items.description: 界面非常糟糕
evidence_items.quote_zh: UI太糟糕了

evidence_items.quote: sometime when installing something and i cancel the task i have to restart the task
evidence_items.description: 取消安装任务后必须重新开始任务
evidence_items.quote_zh: 有时候在安装什么东西时，我取消了任务，结果不得不重新开始这个任务

evidence_items.quote: Horribly clunky UI with very little quality of life, you'll struggle with it a lot and it really becomes frustrating after a while
evidence_items.description: UI笨重，缺乏便捷功能，操作令人沮丧
evidence_items.quote_zh: 极其笨拙的UI，几乎没有便利性功能，你会为此挣扎很久，过一段时间后真的会变得令人沮丧

evidence_items.quote: Would love better task management: queuing from context menus would make so much sense, especially in single-player.
evidence_items.description: 任务管理笨拙，缺少从上下文菜单排队的功能
evidence_items.quote_zh: 希望有更好的任务管理：从上下文菜单中排队会非常合理，尤其是在单人游戏中。

evidence_items.quote: why does the "jobs" menu take up half the screen when I need to click it and then things in front of me? why is it such a pain to use?
evidence_items.description: 工作菜单占据半个屏幕，遮挡前方视野，操作不便
evidence_items.quote_zh: 为什么"工作"菜单占据半个屏幕，而我还需要点击它然后再点击我面前的东西？为什么用起来这么痛苦？

evidence_items.quote: if using the context menu you have to cancel current action to start another
evidence_items.description: 通过右键菜单操作时无法排队任务，必须取消当前动作才能开始下一个
evidence_items.quote_zh: 如果使用上下文菜单，你必须取消当前动作才能开始另一个

evidence_items.quote: social communication tree as inscrutable as possible
evidence_items.description: 社交沟通树难以理解
evidence_items.quote_zh: 尽可能晦涩难懂的社会交流树

evidence_items.quote: the UI can be clumsy, boxes popping up all over the place
evidence_items.description: 界面笨拙，弹窗到处出现
evidence_items.quote_zh: UI可能很笨拙，各种框到处弹出来

evidence_items.quote: i find the UI anoying to use
evidence_items.description: UI使用起来令人烦躁
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我觉得用户界面用起来很烦人

evidence_items.quote: a good idea can be destroyed by a bad UI
evidence_items.description: 糟糕的UI破坏了游戏体验
evidence_items.quote_zh: 一个好点子会被糟糕的用户界面毁掉

evidence_items.quote: clunky UI with a lot of right clicking
evidence_items.description: UI笨重，需要大量右键操作
evidence_items.quote_zh: 笨重的UI，需要大量右键点击

evidence_items.quote: UI was kinda clunky when I played
evidence_items.description: UI操作笨拙
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我玩的时候UI有点笨拙

evidence_items.quote: la interfaz es tan compleja que llega abrumarme
evidence_items.description: 界面过于复杂，令人不知所措
evidence_items.quote_zh: 界面太复杂了，让我感到不知所措

evidence_items.quote: hate the UI
evidence_items.description: 不喜欢游戏的用户界面
evidence_items.quote_zh: 讨厌这个界面

evidence_items.quote: 70-80% of my gameplay time was spent fighting with an extremely user-hostile UI, whether in terms of inventory management
evidence_items.description: 用户敌对的UI导致大量时间浪费在库存管理等操作上
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我70-80%的游戏时间都花在与一个极其不友好的用户界面上作斗争，无论是在库存管理方面

evidence_items.quote: Suit sensors on. No, the submenu. No... no the nested submenu. Not that one. The OTHER nested submenu.
evidence_items.description: 传感器子菜单层级嵌套难以找到正确选项
evidence_items.quote_zh: 开启宇航服传感器。不，是子菜单。不……不是那个嵌套子菜单。不是那个。是另一个嵌套子菜单。

evidence_items.quote: The UI as well as some systems can be a bit clunky.
evidence_items.description: UI和部分系统有些笨拙
evidence_items.quote_zh: 用户界面以及一些系统可能会有点笨拙。

evidence_items.quote: The UI is, to be polite, a wreck. It's overcomplicated and under-designed.
evidence_items.description: UI 过于复杂且设计不佳。
evidence_items.quote_zh: UI说得客气点，就是一塌糊涂。它过度复杂又设计不足。

evidence_items.quote: Want to open up a floor storage bin? Click on it... and get the controls for a pump instead. Turns out you have to keep right-clicking to cycle items on (or near) that tile.
evidence_items.description: 点击地板储物箱却得到泵的控制界面，需要右键循环选择物品。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 想打开地板储物箱？点击它……结果却弹出了泵的控制界面。原来你得不停右键点击才能在该格子上（或附近）循环切换物品。

evidence_items.quote: Inventory management. With a little finesse, you can get a working system set up for salvaging, but you'll always be doing it on the game's terms, not your own. Get ready for a lot of micromanagement.
evidence_items.description: 库存管理复杂，需要大量微操，且只能按游戏的方式操作
evidence_items.quote_zh: 物品栏管理。稍微花点心思，你可以为打捞建立一个可用的系统，但你始终是在按游戏的规则来做，而不是按你自己的。准备好面对大量微观管理吧。

evidence_items.quote: context menu hotkeys are always changing and some are dangerous, like jettison or bash.
evidence_items.description: 上下文菜单热键不断变化，且包含危险操作如抛弃或猛击
evidence_items.quote_zh: 上下文菜单的快捷键总是在变，而且有些很危险，比如抛弃或猛击。

evidence_items.quote: I can't see both my own social stats and the person I am interacting with at the same time.  So I have to click on myself, see what needs are low (Intimacy, Contact, Family, etc.) and then back to the person I'm talking to.  It's a bit cumbersome.
evidence_items.description: 无法同时查看自己与对方的社交属性，需要反复切换，操作繁琐
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我无法同时看到我自己的社交属性和我正在互动的人的社交属性。所以我必须先点开我自己，看看哪些需求偏低（亲密、接触、家庭等），然后再切回我正在交谈的人。这有点麻烦。

evidence_items.quote: The UI is a pain to use later on and every time you do anything that pops up its own screen, it closes your inventory and you have to open it back up and reorganize everything
evidence_items.description: 后期UI难用，弹出新界面时背包关闭，需要重新打开并整理
evidence_items.quote_zh: 后期UI用起来很痛苦，每次你做任何会弹出自己界面的操作时，它都会关闭你的物品栏，你不得不重新打开并重新整理所有东西

evidence_items.quote: Is rather fiddly, the UI isn't dwarf fortress levels of complex, but it isn't simple, it wont warn you before you do stupid things, so ya gotta pay attention and make sure your selecting the right parts, and the right options, the first time.
evidence_items.description: UI操作繁琐复杂，容易误操作
evidence_items.quote_zh: 相当繁琐，UI没有矮人要塞那么复杂，但也不简单，它不会在你做蠢事之前警告你，所以你得注意，确保第一次就选对部件和正确的选项。

evidence_items.quote: awkward interface
evidence_items.description: 界面操作不顺手。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 别扭的界面

evidence_items.quote: your only UI for choosing how much fuel to buy is a draggable slider which makes it impossible to buy small amounts, and the kiosk shows four extra fuel types your ship can't use before the one it can
evidence_items.description: 燃料亭UI过于复杂，滑块无法购买少量燃料，且显示四种无法使用的燃料类型
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你选择购买多少燃料的唯一界面是一个可拖动的滑块，这让你不可能购买少量燃料，而且售货亭在显示你的飞船能用的那一种燃料之前，还显示了四种你的飞船用不了的额外燃料类型

evidence_items.quote: untick the five other categories, only leaving POWER on, otherwise you might uninstall the floor on the same tile as the wall lamp
evidence_items.description: 命令船员卸载壁灯需要多步操作，包括取消勾选其他五个类别
evidence_items.quote_zh: 取消勾选其他五个类别，只留下POWER开启，否则你可能会把壁灯所在同一格的地板也卸载掉

evidence_items.quote: wiggle your cursor to every square you want floors installed to (there is no click-drag bounding box feature)
evidence_items.description: 铺设地板需要逐格移动光标点击，没有点击拖拽框选功能
evidence_items.quote_zh: 把光标挪到每一个你想安装地板的方格上（没有点击拖拽的框选功能）

evidence_items.quote: Climb past the wonky UI
evidence_items.description: 界面存在别扭、不顺手的问题
evidence_items.quote_zh: 爬过那别扭的UI

evidence_items.quote: it's just a bunch of HUD: heads up display menus, Mostly ones that lack polish and don't do much
evidence_items.description: 界面由大量缺乏打磨的HUD菜单堆砌而成
evidence_items.quote_zh: 它只是一堆HUD：抬头显示菜单，大多是缺乏打磨、没什么实际作用的那些

evidence_items.quote: the UI could be improved to just be a bit more user-friendly
evidence_items.description: UI不够用户友好
evidence_items.quote_zh: UI可以改进一下，让它更友好一点

evidence_items.quote: 把東西拖進背包裏是很麻煩的事情
evidence_items.description: 把物品拖进背包很麻烦
evidence_items.quote_zh: 把東西拖進背包裏是很麻煩的事情

evidence_items.quote: you end up spending more time with the god awful UI design than you do actually making any progress
evidence_items.description: UI设计糟糕，玩家花大量时间在界面上而非推进游戏
evidence_items.quote_zh: 到头来，你花在糟糕透顶的UI设计上的时间比实际取得任何进展的时间还多

evidence_items.quote: unintuitiveness, inaccessibility, and clunkiness at its core
evidence_items.description: 游戏核心不直观
evidence_items.quote_zh: 其核心是不直观、难以接近和笨拙

evidence_items.quote: the foreign UI
evidence_items.description: 界面陌生难懂
evidence_items.quote_zh: 外文界面

evidence_items.quote: right clicking on stuff brings up a context menu, but the menu does not appear where you click. It appears at the bottom so you have to move the mouse aaaaaall the way to the bottom of the screen to select an option.
evidence_items.description: 右键菜单出现在屏幕底部而非鼠标位置，需要移动鼠标到屏幕底部才能选择选项
evidence_items.quote_zh: 右键点击东西会弹出一个上下文菜单，但菜单不会出现在你点击的位置。它出现在底部，所以你不得不把鼠标一路移啊啊啊啊到屏幕底部才能选择一个选项。

evidence_items.quote: a clunky UI
evidence_items.description: UI笨重不流畅
evidence_items.quote_zh: 一个笨拙的用户界面

evidence_items.quote: The ship travel menu is a mess, trying to move around the map is sensitive and annoying
evidence_items.description: 飞船旅行菜单混乱，地图移动敏感烦人，难以同时确定航向和查看目标，无法获得目标预测或角度
evidence_items.quote_zh: 飞船旅行菜单一团糟，试图在地图上移动既敏感又烦人

evidence_items.quote: This inconsistency will drive you nuts
evidence_items.description: 游戏交互方式不一致，如打开容器的方式不同
evidence_items.quote_zh: 这种不一致会把你逼疯

evidence_items.quote: Selecting things in the environment is a chore
evidence_items.description: 选择环境中的物体很麻烦
evidence_items.quote_zh: 在环境中选中东西是件苦差事

evidence_items.quote: The actions are thin buttons that you slowly scroll through. If the game is not paused, the buttons frequently shove past each other
evidence_items.description: 动作按钮很细，需要慢慢滚动，且不暂停时会互相推挤
evidence_items.quote_zh: 操作是些细长的按钮，你得慢慢滚动浏览。如果游戏没有暂停，这些按钮经常会互相挤过去

evidence_items.quote: Still very complex, and still unintuative in many ways
evidence_items.description: 游戏在很多方面仍然不直观
evidence_items.quote_zh: 仍然非常复杂，而且在许多方面仍然不直观

evidence_items.quote: game turns into a menu navigator very quickly
evidence_items.description: 游戏很快变成菜单导航
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏很快就变成了菜单导航器

evidence_items.quote: partly due to the fiddly interface
evidence_items.description: 界面操作繁琐不便
evidence_items.quote_zh: 部分原因是繁琐的界面

evidence_items.quote: The UI, while initially daunting, becomes second nature after some time, though it could benefit from further refinement
evidence_items.description: UI虽然上手后习惯，但仍需进一步优化
evidence_items.quote_zh: 用户界面虽然一开始令人望而生畏，但一段时间后就会变得习以为常，不过它仍可以从进一步改进中受益

evidence_items.quote: the UI could use a huuuge QOL where instead of trying to aim the menu at the bottom it should instead be near the mouse cursor or the object one is interacting with..
evidence_items.description: 交互菜单位置不便，容易误点攻击选项
evidence_items.quote_zh: UI可以用一个巨大的QOL改进，与其试图把底部的菜单对准，不如让它靠近鼠标光标或者正在互动的物体……

evidence_items.quote: What is this "Ergonomic and easy to understand UI" you speak of?
evidence_items.description: UI并不符合描述中的符合人体工程学和易于理解
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你说的这个“符合人体工程学且易于理解的UI”是什么？

evidence_items.quote: you have to fight with the ui to make it do what you want for no good reason
evidence_items.description: 界面难用，需要费力操作才能实现意图
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你不得不与用户界面作斗争，让它做你想做的事，却没有任何正当理由。

evidence_items.quote: I could not find a way to do bulk restore of many elements and I had to click one by one each.
evidence_items.description: 无法批量恢复多个元素，只能逐个点击
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我找不到批量恢复许多元素的方法，只能一个一个地点击。

evidence_items.quote: The UI is not always intuitive and the pallet choices often make determining things are being placed/rotated difficult.
evidence_items.description: 用户界面不直观，颜色选择导致放置/旋转物体时难以判断
evidence_items.quote_zh: 用户界面并不总是直观，而调色板选项常常让人难以判断物品的放置/旋转方向。

evidence_items.quote: what your character has equipped is handled with a single paper doll, with very little feedback about how things can be equipped or managed
evidence_items.description: 装备管理界面反馈不足，不清楚如何装备物品
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你的角色装备了什么，是通过一个单一的纸娃娃来处理的，关于如何装备或管理物品的反馈极少

evidence_items.quote: a screen about as cluttered and unintuitive as one would imagine the control panel for a spacecraft you have never seen
evidence_items.description: 界面杂乱且不直观
evidence_items.quote_zh: 一个像你从未见过的航天器控制面板那样杂乱且不直观的屏幕

evidence_items.quote: UI is bad and there seems to be no efforts to improve it
evidence_items.description: UI糟糕且没有改进努力
evidence_items.quote_zh: UI很糟糕，而且似乎没有任何改进的努力

evidence_items.quote: Can't determine what is what from ceiling to floor, other than mouse over
evidence_items.description: 角色创建界面难以辨认，只能靠鼠标悬停来区分元素
evidence_items.quote_zh: 从天花板到地板，除了鼠标悬停之外，无法分辨什么是什么

evidence_items.quote: The game's UI is somewhat awkward
evidence_items.description: 游戏UI有些别扭
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏的界面有些别扭

evidence_items.quote: the UI doesnt need to be this finicky
evidence_items.description: 界面操作繁琐
evidence_items.quote_zh: UI不需要这么繁琐

evidence_items.quote: I found the menus clunky
evidence_items.description: 菜单操作笨拙
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我觉得菜单很笨重

evidence_items.quote: Lots of menus and cycling through objects to find what you need to repair and loot etc.  And needs a bit more work to cleanup a game play loop that is clean and obvious
evidence_items.description: 游戏循环需要大量菜单操作和循环切换对象
evidence_items.quote_zh: 大量的菜单，还要在物体之间来回切换，才能找到你需要修理和拾取的东西等等。而且还需要再多下点功夫，清理出一个干净、明确、上面再叠几层机制的游戏循环。

evidence_items.quote: The most common options are numbered, but those numbers are not guaranteed to be the same for the same interaction. So you have to actually look each time, lest you disassemble, when you intended to repair.
evidence_items.description: 交互选项编号不固定，容易误操作
evidence_items.quote_zh: 最常见的选项是有编号的，但这些编号并不保证在同一个互动中始终相同。所以每次你都得实际看一眼，免得你本想修理，结果却拆解了。

evidence_items.quote: the UI is absolute garbage lacking even obvious basics
evidence_items.description: UI 缺少基本功能，整体很差
evidence_items.quote_zh: UI完全是垃圾，连明显的基础功能都缺失

evidence_items.quote: if you right click on an object to interact with it, a menu comes up at the bottom of the screen instead of near the item, so you move your mouse all the way down there to select
evidence_items.description: 右键交互菜单出现在屏幕底部而非物品附近，需要移动鼠标
evidence_items.quote_zh: 如果你右键点击一个物体来与它互动，菜单会出现在屏幕底部，而不是物品附近，所以你得把鼠标一路移到下面去选择

evidence_items.quote: Awful interface: Now, look I played NEO Scavenger alright. I love that game but it had the most horrific GUI I have ever seen modern video game. This game's GUI is a bit more sophisticated than that but it still suffers from the same problems. You have to click through things multiple times to give simple commands and there is an obtuse choices menu you have to scroll through for everything.
evidence_items.description: 界面操作繁琐，需要多次点击和滚动菜单
evidence_items.quote_zh: 糟糕的界面：听着，我玩过《NEO Scavenger》，好吧。我喜欢那款游戏，但它有着我在现代电子游戏中见过的最可怕的图形用户界面。这款游戏的图形用户界面比那个稍微精致一些，但仍然存在同样的问题。你必须多次点击才能下达简单的命令，而且所有操作都要在一个晦涩难懂、需要滚动浏览的选项菜单里进行。

evidence_items.quote: overcluttered mess
evidence_items.description: 界面过于杂乱
evidence_items.quote_zh: 过度杂乱的烂摊子

evidence_items.quote: the common inventory actions don't have specific hotkeys, so doing basic actions involve a lot of clicking
evidence_items.description: 常用物品栏操作没有快捷键，导致大量点击
evidence_items.quote_zh: 常见的物品栏操作没有专门的快捷键，所以做基本操作需要大量点击

evidence_items.quote: Clunkly UI.
evidence_items.description: UI笨拙
evidence_items.quote_zh: 笨拙的用户界面。

evidence_items.quote: the (slightly too obtuse) building and deconstructing menus
evidence_items.description: 建造和拆解菜单过于晦涩难懂
evidence_items.quote_zh: 那（稍微过于晦涩的）建造和拆除菜单

evidence_items.quote: It might be because the UI is a little difficult to read
evidence_items.description: UI有点难以阅读
evidence_items.quote_zh: 这可能是因为用户界面有点难以阅读

evidence_items.quote: mostly just a more intuitive UI
evidence_items.description: UI 不够直观
evidence_items.quote_zh: 主要只是一个更直观的界面

evidence_items.quote: I wasn't expecting the UI to have me carefully hover the mouse over each pixel of a derelict vessel in search for the elusive component part
evidence_items.description: UI要求玩家在废弃飞船上仔细悬停鼠标寻找组件，非常繁琐。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我没想到UI会让我小心翼翼地把鼠标悬停在废弃飞船的每一个像素上，寻找那难以捉摸的组件零件

evidence_items.quote: the manual controls are full screen for a tiny panel and a just get annoying after a while
evidence_items.description: 手动控制面板全屏显示但内容很少，令人烦躁
evidence_items.quote_zh: 手动控制为了一个小小的面板却占满整个屏幕，过一会儿就变得很烦人

evidence_items.quote: Trade UI is horrible, have to scroll every time you open a sub-list
evidence_items.description: 每次打开子列表都需要滚动
evidence_items.quote_zh: 交易界面很糟糕，每次打开子列表都得滚动

evidence_items.quote: a very difficult and unintuitive interface
evidence_items.description: 界面非常困难且不直观
evidence_items.quote_zh: 一个非常困难且不直观的界面

evidence_items.quote: The way you interact with the game is just so poor and not user friendly at all
evidence_items.description: 与游戏的交互方式很差，不友好
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你与游戏互动的方式实在太糟糕了，完全不友好

evidence_items.quote:
les menus sont tellement laids qu'ils pourraient être exposés dans des musées d'art contemporain.

Ces derniers ne sont au mieux pas ergonomiques, aux pires incompréhensibles.
evidence_items.description: 菜单丑陋且不直观
evidence_items.quote_zh:
菜单丑得简直可以拿去当代艺术博物馆里展出。

这些菜单往好了说是毫无人体工学，往坏了说是完全让人看不懂。

evidence_items.quote: I then realized I don't know how to exit out of socializing, so I just quit the game
evidence_items.description: 社交界面没有退出选项，只能退出游戏
evidence_items.quote_zh: 然后我意识到我不知道怎么退出社交，所以我直接退出了游戏

evidence_items.quote: you can’t tab through crewman.  You have to see them to switch to them.
evidence_items.description: 无法通过Tab键切换船员，必须看到他们才能切换
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你无法用Tab键切换船员。你必须看到他们才能切换过去。

evidence_items.quote: nightmarish in game interface that spoils what fun there is to be had in it, not in an interesting fashion but really a very mundane unpolished sort of way
evidence_items.description: 游戏界面糟糕且未打磨，影响游戏体验
evidence_items.quote_zh: 噩梦般的游戏界面破坏了其中本可获得的乐趣，不是以有趣的方式，而是以一种非常平庸、未经打磨的方式

evidence_items.quote: has a painful UI to get through
evidence_items.description: 用户界面令人痛苦
evidence_items.quote_zh: 有一个令人痛苦的UI需要忍受

evidence_items.quote: Unfortunately, the UI and controls just aren't there.
evidence_items.description: UI和控制系统不到位，缺乏可读性
evidence_items.quote_zh: 不幸的是，UI和操作就是不到位。

evidence_items.quote: Not the least bit intuitive and clumsy interface.
evidence_items.description: 界面笨拙不直观
evidence_items.quote_zh: 界面一点也不直观，而且很笨拙。

evidence_items.quote: Every single thing you do is a pain, not because it's difficult, but because it's cumbersome
evidence_items.description: 所有操作都因界面笨重而变得痛苦
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你做的每一件事都是一种折磨，不是因为难，而是因为太繁琐

evidence_items.quote: the interface is entirely obtuse
evidence_items.description: 界面晦涩难懂
evidence_items.quote_zh: 界面完全令人费解

evidence_items.quote: the interface is clunky, kind of hard to read
evidence_items.description: 界面笨重且难以阅读
evidence_items.quote_zh: 界面很笨重，有点难以阅读

evidence_items.quote: There is no exit button on the main page
evidence_items.description: 主菜单没有退出按钮。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 主页上没有退出按钮

player_themes.title: UI笨重，缺乏便捷功能，操作令人沮丧

evidence_items.quote: Horribly clunky UI with very little quality of life, you'll struggle with it a lot and it really becomes frustrating after a while
evidence_items.description: UI笨重，缺乏便捷功能，操作令人沮丧
evidence_items.quote_zh: 极其笨拙的UI，几乎没有便利性功能，你会为此挣扎很久，过一段时间后真的会变得令人沮丧

evidence_items.quote: The UI as well as some systems can be a bit clunky.
evidence_items.description: UI和部分系统有些笨拙
evidence_items.quote_zh: 用户界面以及一些系统可能会有点笨拙。

player_themes.title: UI和控制系统不到位，缺乏可读性

evidence_items.quote: Unfortunately, the UI and controls just aren't there.
evidence_items.description: UI和控制系统不到位，缺乏可读性
evidence_items.quote_zh: 不幸的是，UI和操作就是不到位。

evidence_items.quote: hate the UI
evidence_items.description: 不喜欢游戏的用户界面
evidence_items.quote_zh: 讨厌这个界面

evidence_items.quote: UI is bad and there seems to be no efforts to improve it
evidence_items.description: UI糟糕且没有改进努力
evidence_items.quote_zh: UI很糟糕，而且似乎没有任何改进的努力

evidence_items.quote: UI is ass but eh, you get used to it
evidence_items.description: UI很差
evidence_items.quote_zh: UI很烂，但呃，你会习惯的
